title: fraxinus americana var. quadrangulata
intro: Fraxinus americana var. quadrangulata, commonly known as the four-angled manchineel, is a variety of the white ash tree, which is native to North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of F. americana var. quadrangulata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. Further research is needed to fully explore the potential health benefits and therapeutic applications of this plant.
